description_en: Unbinds and deletes tags from specified lightweight resources, such as instances, snapshots, disks, images, commands, and firewall rules
description_zh: 为指定的轻量资源（实例、快照、磁盘、镜像、命令、防火墙规则）统一解绑并删除标签
kebab_example: aliyun swas-open untag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type instance --resource-id s-bw526m1vi6x20c6g0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UntagResources

parameters.help_en: The client token that you want to use to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The resource type. Valid values:

instance
snapshot
customimage
command
firewallrule
disk
parameters.help_zh:
资源类型，取值范围： 

instance：实例。
snapshot：快照。
customimage：自定义镜像。
command：命令。
firewallrule：防火墙规则。
disk：磁盘
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to remove all tags from the specified one or more resources. This parameter takes effect only if the TagKey.N parameter is not set. Valid values:

true: deletes all tags that are added to the specific lightweight resource. If no tags are added to the specific lightweight resource, the deletion operation is ignored.
false: does not delete the tags that are added to the specific lightweight resource.

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
是否全部删除，只针对TagKey.N为空时有效。 取值范围：

true：删除指定轻量资源绑定的全部标签。若指定的轻量资源未绑定任何标签，则不做处理。
false：不删除指定轻量资源绑定的任何标签。

默认是 false
parameters.name: all

parameters.help_en: The resource IDs. You can specify up to 50 resource IDs
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en: The key of tag N. Valid values of N: 1 to 20
parameters.name: tag_key
